description: Amp, Droid and Junie under their previous npm names.
why: The old names are what machines installed before each move still report. @sourcegraph/amp now installs @ampcode/cli as a nested dependency, and forbid_rows holds that nested copy absent as a global, so Amp here is found through the old name alone. Junie's postinstall also writes ~/.local/bin/junie, so must_contain pins the package row.
